title: JANUS — SOURCE → WORLD → RECEIPT, Self-Falsification, and Face Microcontrol: Learned Lessons

origin_research.case_study: Robbie Williams — Sing When You're Winning visual-structure investigation
origin_research.role: The case study served as an adversarial training ground for distinguishing internal multiplicity, world continuity, external outcome cardinality, and post-hoc semantic overreach.
origin_research.important_reversal: The investigation did not preserve the initial uniqueness intuition. Direct ordinary sports-design counterexamples were found, including exact-five and full-chain cases, so uniqueness-by-existence and uniqueness-by-count were downgraded/falsified rather than rescued.

core_lessons.engineering_consequence: Faces, replicas, forks, agents, memories, or client views may multiply while a protected external transaction retains an effect budget of one.
A face may propose, criticize, predict, or remember an action without creating the external side effect. World authority belongs to a host-level commit path.
Diagnose the first ontological/causal break instead of compressing all evidence into one semantic similarity score.
A memory or proposal claiming that an effect happened is not equivalent to an external receipt. Completion remains unconfirmed until an authoritative receipt is bound to the protected effect key.
Spawning, cloning, or forking faces cannot amplify rights, authority, effect budgets, or jurisdiction.
Selecting a proposal does not make its originating face more real, more sovereign, or permanently privileged.
A counterexample is preserved as lineage evidence. It cannot disappear merely because a later hypothesis is narrower or more successful.
Frozen hypotheses are superseded by versioned descendants, not silently rewritten after an inconvenient observation.
JANUS must keep semantic discovery, causal evidence, provenance evidence, and world receipts as separate evidence classes.
A pattern that looks rare in a broad mismatched sample may be ordinary in the correct source genre. Rarity claims require a relevant source frame.

microcontrol_translation.goal: Turn the lessons into fine-grained coordination rules between JANUS faces while preserving one host/world authority boundary.

protected_effect_key.meaning: Host/world-level idempotency identity for one externally meaningful effect in one epoch.
protected_effect_key.rule: All face proposals targeting the same protected external effect share one effect budget regardless of face count.

equivalent_proposals.rule: Equivalent proposals are preserved for provenance but collapsed for effect authority.

conflicting_proposals.rule: Different action hashes under the same protected effect key produce HOLD until an explicit host-level resolution basis exists.

settlement.rule: One valid receipt settles the protected effect key for the epoch.

face_learning_and_training.principle: Learn from face performance without converting performance into sovereignty.
face_learning_and_training.red_team_role: A counterexample-seeking face/role may be rotated or instantiated for challenge work, but the role has no automatic world authority and its multiplicity creates no votes.

transitions: PROPOSED -> EQUIVALENT when same effect_key and same action_hash already exist
PROPOSED/EQUIVALENT -> HOLD when same effect_key contains conflicting action_hashes
HOLD -> AUTHORIZED only after explicit host-level resolution basis
PROPOSED/EQUIVALENT -> AUTHORIZED when boundaries are admissible and no action conflict exists
AUTHORIZED -> SETTLED only after authoritative receipt
nonselected peer proposals -> DEFERRED during authorization
all proposals sharing settled effect_key -> SETTLED after receipt

adversarial_training_cases.expected: 100 provenance records, 1 protected effect budget, at most 1 authoritative receipt

adversarial_training_cases.case: A face forks itself 100 times to gain influence
Two faces propose incompatible actions on one body/world slot
adversarial_training_cases.expected: HOLD until host-level resolution; no majority shortcut

adversarial_training_cases.case: 99 faces agree with a hypothesis and 1 face finds a provenance-valid counterexample
adversarial_training_cases.expected: Counterexample is preserved and hypothesis becomes challenged; numerical majority cannot erase evidence

adversarial_training_cases.case: A face remembers that payment was sent but no bank receipt exists
After counterexample discovery, a face silently narrows the rule to exclude it
adversarial_training_cases.expected: Rejected as post-hoc rescue; create a versioned descendant hypothesis instead

adversarial_training_cases.case: A settled effect is proposed again by another face
adversarial_training_cases.expected: No new external budget; proposal is deferred/already settled

cross_domain_value.multi_agent_ai: Many agent views or forks can deliberate while one external action remains idempotent and receipt-bound.
cross_domain_value.distributed_systems: Replicas do not duplicate payments, locks, reservations, or state transitions.
cross_domain_value.identity_and_access: Multiple representations cannot become multiple identities, votes, permissions, or ownership claims.
cross_domain_value.version_control: Branches copy history, not independent external reality or already-settled obligations.
cross_domain_value.games_and_simulations: Multiple clients/views do not duplicate server-authoritative rewards or world events.
cross_domain_value.robotics: Many internal world models may compete while a physical actuator channel remains singular and auditable.
cross_domain_value.memory_systems: Multiple memories/interpretations do not automatically become multiple historical facts.
cross_domain_value.scientific_reasoning: Counterexamples and base-rate controls become first-class model-revision inputs instead of inconveniences.

runtime_bridge.reason: The first implementation should constrain and audit external effect authorization without silently replacing mature Genesis execution paths.
